title: A proposed strategy for enhancing collaboration between schools and their local communities
core_idea: Develop a guiding philosophy and vision for effective school–community partnerships by examining what such partnerships involve, their aims, and how they can be accepted and implemented to support continuous improvement in education.
tldr: The study proposes a theoretical, qualitative strategy to guide collaboration between schools and local communities, clarifying partnership roles, objectives, acceptance factors, and implementation approaches to strengthen and sustain educational improvement.
